# EVKII

**AI creative and growth systems built by operators.**

EVKII is an operator-led AI marketing agency for DTC, eCommerce, supplement, CPG, wellness, fintech and high-ticket lead-gen brands. We build ultra-real AI creative, UGC-style video, paid media creative, conversion-focused websites, Amazon storefronts, CRM/Klaviyo growth, lead-gen systems and AI growth ops.

## What we build

- **AI creative production:** ultra-real product scenes, paid social assets, ad concepts and testing matrices.
- **UGC and shoppable video:** hooks, scripts, creator-style videos, product demos and video systems for ads and commerce.
- **Websites and landing pages:** high-converting sites, product pages, lead-gen pages and campaign funnels.
- **Amazon growth:** storefronts, listing creative, A+ content direction and marketplace-ready brand systems.
- **CRM and lifecycle:** Klaviyo flows, email/SMS campaigns, segmentation and retention systems.
- **AI growth ops:** reporting, workflows, content operations and agentic systems for lean growth teams.

## Operator-led positioning

EVKII is led by Heath Squier, a founder-level CMO/CGO and growth operator. The agency is built around the belief that creative should not sit apart from offer strategy, landing pages, tracking, CRM, conversion rate and revenue.

> "I've sat in every seat - operator, founder, marketer, P&L owner. EVKII is the agency I wish I had when I was scaling."
>
> - Heath Squier, Founder
